reviewContext.userProblem: The round-16 audit of feat/ai-capture found three medium defects. (1) CadViewport.tsx:153-157 fits only drawnBodies() on double-click (:531), and the initial-fit effect (:250-258) requires bodies. A sketch-only page with a visible rectangle near (600,-600) mm is framed on the origin, so the drawing is off-screen (corner NDC X -7.21 to -6.47). (2) history.ts:639 re-runs the even-depth some() over the shared whole-profile loop array on every whole-sketch extrusion. Holes come first, so a 256-hole plate with 32 extrusions costs 8,224 visits through checkCadPage. (3) scene.ts:220-224 charges an all-depth-zero scan 0 work, so the 4096-work profile-cache admission (scene.ts:528-536) is never reached. 256 circles x 32 extrusions and 4096 circles x 2 extrusions each cost 8,192 depth checks.
requiredOutcomes: function-cad-fit-ignores-visible-sketches (R16-1; car16-p1): with no drawn body, Fit and the initial fit frame the visible sketch.entityLines() endpoints. Body pages keep the body-only fit, and empty pages keep the [-50,50] fallback. The provisional sketch-only initial fit is local, not published, and not marked fitted, so the first body arrival runs the published body fit, including after a page switch. A DOM test at 800x600 shows the corners in NDC [-1,1] after the initial fit and after pan plus dblclick. A hidden distant sketch does not change the fit. viewport.test.tsx asserts 'ok sketch fit'.

performance-cad-shared-perforated-profile-depth-rescans (R16-2; car16-p2): the even-depth search runs only when semantic.loops is present; whole profiles keep an O(1) loops.length===0 check. With the new cadGeometryWork.evenDepthVisits counter: 0 for K=1 and K=32 (before: 257 and 8,224), errors [] and bounds [0,0,0]-[200,200,K]. Hole-only and loops:[] selections give cad.profile.empty, and a boundary selection still searches. The ordinary 500-feature document gives 0.

performance-capture-shared-depth-zero-profile-rescans (R16-3; car16-p3): the all-zero scan charges searched=loops.length (prepared unchanged). It is admitted on the single 4096 threshold, or cumulatively per array only when loops.length >= PROFILE_CACHE_PENDING_MIN_WORK (64); the cached value is the same array. 4096 circles x 2: depthVisits 4096, admitted 1, hits 1. 256 x 32: depthVisits 4096, lookups and hits 16. 256 x 64: hits 48. 63 x 2: pendingUpdates 0. One-use entitiesPerSketch 1: pendingUpdates 0, depthVisits 500, maxDirectWork 1. Oracle bytes are equal, and the ordinary pins are kept with pendingUpdates 0.
nonGoals: No change to the low findings at packages/ui-solid/src/cad/sketch-overlay.ts:306 and packages/core/src/capture/cad-request.ts:209.

No change to Canvas.tsx, apps/desktop/src/App.tsx, camera3d.ts, sketch-authoring.ts, picking, loops.ts, construction.ts, check.ts, bounds.ts, history.test.ts, PROFILE_CACHE_MIN_WORK, the mixed-depth normalization path, explicit-selection capture behaviour, goldens or capture bytes.
No docs or design-doc edits by workers. No new dependency. No Rust changes.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, noUncheckedIndexedAccess-safe reads without non-null assertions, Biome clean on touched files.

artifactRoots are exactly ["target", "tmp/cad3d"]. Evidence goes under tmp/car16-r16/<planId>/. Each gate exports its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR (target/r16-viewport-fit, target/r16-cad-depth, target/r16-capture-depth). No *.test.ts or *.test.tsx file may be left under target/ or tmp/.
Per-plan gates are focused. bun run typecheck, bun run lint and mise run verify run once at integration.
Workers follow the SHA-256 pre/post hash, intent snapshot and drift-stop rules of car16-00-overview.md. Each plan records a fail-before log and a passing gate log.
The 26.2 timing rule applies. Work counters only. At most two bun test processes at once. Never relax existing assertions or helpers.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R16-1 uses sketch lines only when no body is drawn.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Adding them alongside bodies would move the camera on body pages with visible sketches and break the existing centre-pick and dblclick-equality assertions (cad-viewport.dom.tsx:222-238).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The R16-1 provisional fit uses setCamera only and runs at most once per mount.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: NodettoCanvas caches every published camera as the next initialCamera (Canvas.tsx:144, :186-190), so a published provisional camera would suppress the body fit after a page switch.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R16-2 relies on the depth-0 invariant of successful whole profiles.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: buildLoops returns cad.profile.empty for no loops (loops.ts:696), depths count containment within the set, and crossings are rejected (loops.ts:610-612). Explicit selections keep the search.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R16-3 charges into searched and gates the pending map with a 64-loop floor.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The existing prepared pins stay unchanged. Ordinary, mixed-depth and one-use small profiles allocate nothing new, and above the floor bookkeeping costs at most 1/64 of the scan it amortizes.

intentionalTradeoffs: On a page with bodies, a visible sketch far from them is still not framed by Fit (today's behaviour).
All-zero profiles below 64 loops keep rescanning at fewer than 64 visits per extrusion.
The one-use guard's maxDirectWork 1 holds only after the fix; it is a guard, not fail-before evidence.
supportedEdgeCases: A sketch-only page, a hidden distant sketch, an empty page, a body page with visible sketches, a page switch before the first body response, and initialCamera restoration.
Whole-profile 256-hole plates with K=1 and K=32; hole-only, empty and boundary explicit selections; the ordinary 500-feature document.
All-zero profiles of 63, 64, 256 and 4096 circles; one-use one-circle profiles; mixed-depth and explicit-subset regressions; the shared PCB test.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: GPU and WebGL rendering, packaged desktop, Boa latency, native rendering and image bytes, Tauri IPC, MCP delivery and cross-platform byte determinism.

acceptanceCriteria: Sketch-only page at 800x600: all four rectangle corners project inside NDC [-1,1] after the initial fit, and again after a middle-button pan followed by a real dblclick. This fails before the fix.
A hidden sketch near (5000,5000) does not change the initial camera. An empty page's dblclick equals fitBounds([-50,-50,-50],[50,50,50],800/600).

Page switch before the first body response: after remount and body arrival, the last camera equals fitBounds([-20,-20,0],[20,20,0],1), and the first published camera is that body fit. The provisional camera is never published.
Existing body fit, centre pick, dblclick equality and savedCamera remount assertions are unedited and pass. The gate output contains ok light, ok dark and ok sketch fit.
